_comment: The recorded baseline for alhazen's on-disk compatibility contracts, as
declared in CHANGELOG.md. tests/unit/test_contracts.py compares the live
code against this file so that breaking one of the three promises fails
the suite here, rather than failing a stranger's analysis a year from now.
This file is append-only in the same sense the contracts are. Adding an RNG
stream, a reserved event, or a bumped schema version means updating it in
the same commit, with a CHANGELOG entry. Removing anything from it means a
major version and a documented migration -- see docs/versioning.md.
